use_case: Coding agent adds a rate-limit throttle to a freight-quote API client in a logistics backend. The internal doc and the vendor's public docs give different production limits.
situation: While looking around, the agent read the internal integration doc, which says the Rapidex production limit is 120 req/min. Later it fetched the vendor's limits page, which says 60 req/min for the same plan in production. Nothing in the session says which one is right.
must_keep: Keep both the internal doc excerpt (120 req/min in production) and the vendor page excerpt (60 req/min in production) so the agent can point out the conflict instead of quietly picking one.
may_drop: Drop the Glob listing, the Correios throttle grep hit, the sandbox CHANGELOG entry, the current client source, and the build, test and git logs.
why_judges_fail: A judge may see the two limits as duplicate facts and keep only one. It may also keep the Correios throttle block, which shares more words with the goal, or the CHANGELOG entry, which also gives a Rapidex limit but is for sandbox.
goal: beleza, agora coloca o throttle no cliente da Rapidex com o limite certo de produção
